Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Bloomington for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events across Bloomington and Richfield, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 14 (The Santa Experience at Mall of America) through December 24 (The Santa Experience at Mall of America), with the Richfield Holiday Lights Parade (December 10), the Christmas Celebration at the Pond House (December 12) and the Bloomington Winter Lights Tour (all December) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Bloomington

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Bloomington, including 1 from Richfield and 1 moved from Minneapolis (The Santa Experience at Mall of America)
  • 4 free events, including the Richfield Holiday Lights Parade and the Bloomington Winter Lights Tour
  • Meet Santa: The Santa Experience at Mall of America and a Breakfast with Santa Cow at Chick-fil-A
  • Parades and tree lightings: Richfield Holiday Lights Parade on December 10
  • Season: November 14 to December 24

Planning a bigger day out? Bloomington families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Minneapolis, which covers the Holly Trolley, Christkindl market and the big holiday theater shows.
